Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL3526 (Glycogen phosphorylase, muscle form). Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Require exact standard relation '=' and non-null pChEMBL values. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit output to the first 1000 rows.
